QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Ulrika's Offer
QuestInfo.0: What exactly happened here? Listen to Ulrika.
QuestInfo.1: Ulrika says she's a member of the Resistance, and that she'll introduce you to the others if you do her a favor first. Defeat the Dust Boxes at #bEdelstein Strolling Path 4#k to find #bBlack Plastic Bags#k, and defeat the Streetlights at the #bStreetlight Row#k to find #bLightbulbs#k. Then bring it all back to her.
QuestInfo.2: You've brought the items as Ulrika requested.

default.0: Uh, you're missing something. Let me say it again: bring me #b15#k  #bBlack Plastic Bags#k and 15 #bStreetlight's Lightbulbs#k.\r\n
